faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild engines for all BMW M3 models?
faqLeft.a: Yes — we rebuild and replace engines across every M3 generation, from the E36 up to the current E46.

faqLeft.q: Do I keep my original engine, or do you send me a different one?
faqLeft.a: We rebuild the engine your car already has wherever possible, keeping its matching engine number to avoid compatibility risks.
Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option upon registration matching.

faqLeft.q: What warranty comes with a rebuild?
faqLeft.a: Every rebuild comes with a 12 month unlimited-mileage warranty.

faqRight.a: Nationwide car collection from £70, with most vehicles recovered within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from arrival at the workshop.

faqRight.q: How much does a BMW M3 engine rebuild cost?
faqRight.a: 4-cylinder from £1,900, 6-cylinder from £2,800, and M3 from £5,500 based on exact engine code and condition.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
